segments.contextAfter: The app can still support the AutoFill behavior for specific fields by annotating them with the one-time code text content type. In AppKit, set the field’s [`contentType`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AppKit/NSTextContent/contentType) to [`oneTimeCode`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AppKit/NSTextContentType/oneTimeCode). For a SwiftUI app, use the view modifier [`textContentType(_:)`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/SwiftUI/View/textContentType(_:)-ufdv) to set the content type to [`oneTimeCode`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/UIKit/UITextContentType/oneTimeCode). Otherwise, without these annotations, the app never shows AutoFill for detected one-time codes.
